data.name: Mukul
data.gender_notes: Mukul is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit mukula, 'bud, blossom'. Its root is Sanskrit mukula (मुकुल). A classical Sanskrit term for a bud. Mukul is a Sanskrit name meaning “Bud; blossom”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mukul expresses “Bud; blossom”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mukul total 15, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
